statement: A laboratory self-test run of the proposed SDX data-sharing program. It records what was executed and what each case observed. It is not a conformance result, issues no certification and confers no right to use the SDX Protocol name or marks.

implementation.name: sdx-v01
implementation.description: An SDX v0.1 library whose key operations go through the p sdx wallet module; its JOSE implementation is a fork of jose 6.2.13
implementation.source: impl/sdx in the contributor's repository, with impl/sdx-module and impl/ring-proof
implementation.statement: Implements SDX v0.1 (Draft); conformance not demonstrated

driver.transport: JSON lines; one process per session

notes: Keys are held by a p sdx module instance; the driver imports each request's root through the module's host interface. split answers the two root public keys and derive answers no private key (contained keys).

The topic manager decides admission; the driver keeps the admitted outputs per topic, as an overlay engine does for a topic manager. There is no per-topic index, so lookup and the fault hook are not offered.
The secrets and offset hooks and the secp256k1 symmetric key are not offered.

implementation.name: sdx-go
implementation.description: An SDX v0.1 implementation written from the specification text alone: the record envelope, keys on both curves, and an admission service with its per-topic index; its JOSE implementation is go-jose v4.1.9
implementation.statement: Implements SDX v0.1 (Draft); conformance not demonstrated

driver.transport: JSON lines; one process per session

notes: Per its README, go-jose draws content-encryption keys, IVs and ephemeral keys from a source it keeps private, so the driver ignores the contract's frozen random values.
Per its README it does not write overlay or external placement, and does not read dual-signed records. Its admission service keeps state for one process and takes raw transactions without proofs.
